task: Who is the founder of Five Guys?

c1.note: Five Guys' own site and Feb 2026 release call Jerry Murrell the founder.

c2.note: The official our-story page says 'Five Guys founder Jerry Murrell'.

c3.note: Wikipedia says founded in 1986 by Janie and Jerry Murrell; the company page shows both as the couple who started it.

c5.note: Wikipedia infobox lists Founders: Jerry Murrell, Janie Murrell.

c6.note: The official site names Jerry as founder and Wikipedia credits both Jerry and Janie; the sons are described as the original 'Five Guys', though 'co-founders' is a loose characterization.

c7.note: Jerry and Janie with their sons started the business in 1986.

c8.note: The first restaurant opened in 1986 in Arlington, Virginia.

c15.note: Official page says 'three sons'; other sources say four, but the claim matches the page wording.

c19.note: Wikipedia states Jerry and sons Jim, Matt, Chad, Ben were the original Five Guys.

c20.note: Fifth son Tyler came later (two years after founding, ~1988 per Wikipedia); the 1987 birth year is a minor discrepancy, but the substance holds.

c21.note: Wikipedia says 'a fifth son, Tyler, two years later' (after the 1986 founding).

c22.note: Wikipedia says all five sons are involved in the business.

c24.note: Privately held, family-run company; ownership by the Murrell family is consistent with sources and general knowledge, though not stated explicitly in the passages.

c25.note: Quote matches the official site text.

c26.note: BU profile (2023) lists him as CEO; he is described as founder and still the face of the company in the 2026 release.

c27.note: Wikipedia says HQ moved to Alexandria, VA in 2023.

c28.note: Franchising began in early 2003 per Wikipedia and the official story.

c29.note: Wikipedia, as of 2026, says over 1,900 locations; the official site also says more than 1,900.

c31.note: Wikipedia states the 32.8% 2010-2011 sales increase and fastest-growing status; historical context, not about the founder.

c32.note: Wikipedia states five locations in the DC metro area by 2001; background, not the founder.

c30.note: The Wikipedia infobox lists revenue of US$2.347 billion for 2023. It is background rather than an answer to who the founder is, and it is not the most recent year.

c33.note: The Marketscreener and Zonebourse insider pages list 'Victor Jerome Murrell' as founder and president of Five Guys, Inc.
